page_title: DOR 3-3 STU | Dortmund v Stuttgart 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+6' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
90+4' Substitution. Jamie Leweling is replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
90+3' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Angelo Stiller is replaced by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
90+3' Here's the change. Maximilian Beier leaves the pitch and Fabio Silva (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.

90+1' 3 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Chris Fuhrich, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who beats Gregor Kobel with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:3.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' 3 - 2 GOAL! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) runs onto a pass from Maximilian Beier after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 3:2.
86' Good movement by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

83' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
81' The referee is firm and issues Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) a deserved yellow card.
80' It is time for a substitution. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) is on for Chema Andres.
80' The game has come to an end for Maximilian Mittelstadt. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
77' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka will be replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
74' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

74' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Stuttgart.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Tiago Tomas.
73' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) replaces Julian Brandt.
73' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
71' 2 - 2 GOAL - 2:2! The corner comes over and Maximilian Mittelstadt flicks on with his head to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
70' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) steps up to send the ball in.
70' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) as his effort only hit the wall. Stuttgart have a corner.
69' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
68' Benjamin Brand couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Stuttgart.
65' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!

63' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Gregor Kobel makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
58' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Stuttgart.
56' Celebrations are cut short for Dortmund as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
55' Wait! Referee Benjamin Brand has indicated he is going to review the Dortmund goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' Goal! Julian Brandt produces a great pass that finds Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
52' A pass from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is intercepted by Alexander Nubel and the move breaks down.
49' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
47' 2 - 1 GOAL! Bilal El Khannouss meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
44' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
41' 2 - 0 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 2:0.
38' Emre Can (Dortmund) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul after dangerous play.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Emre Can (Dortmund) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Alexander Nubel.
33' Emre Can (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
33' Referee Benjamin Brand is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Dortmund!
32' Celebrations by Dortmund are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

32' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benjamin Brand with no other option than to blow for a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Dortmund.
31' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

30' A precise low pass is received by Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
29' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

27' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
24' Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
19' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 38:62.
15' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

13' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
12' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
10' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
7' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Benjamin Brand stops the game and makes a call.
7' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Rough tackle by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. Benjamin Brand had a clear view and blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will officiate today.
